Starting from a=335, b=319, c=806, d=775, the state at the end of each iteration (a, b, c, d) is:

| i | branch | a | b | c | d |
|---|--------|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | if (775 > 599) | 83 | 41 | 230 | 15 |
| 1 | else | 243 | 364 | 230 | 19 |
| 2 | else | 932 | 312 | 230 | 23 |
| 3 | else | 134 | 469 | 230 | 27 |
| 4 | else | 67 | 301 | 230 | 31 |
| 5 | else | 708 | 867 | 230 | 35 |
| 6 | else | 371 | 393 | 230 | 39 |
| 7 | else | 950 | 62 | 230 | 43 |
| 8 | else | 715 | 23 | 230 | 47 |
| 9 | else | 429 | 39 | 230 | 51 |

Iteration 0 takes the `if` branch because d=775 > 599, so c = (335² + 4) % 1009 = 112229 % 1009 = 230. Every later iteration sees d ≤ 51, so it takes the `else` branch and c stays 230.

The function returns a·10000 + b = 429·10000 + 39 = 4290039.

ANSWER: 4290039
